visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a beige long-sleeved dress, sits at a light-colored wooden folding table in a bright studio. On the table sit a beige thermal cooker and a smaller matching container. The background features white translucent curtains and a modern stainless steel range hood. (2) A male photographer wearing a white t-shirt, beige pants, and a blue medical mask enters the frame from the left, adjusting the props on the table while the woman maintains a thinking pose. (3) The camera pans across a minimalist white kitchen studio with wooden shelves and white cabinets. Studio lighting equipment is visible. (4) Close-up shot of the beige thermal cooker on the wooden table. A hand with manicured nails opens the latch, revealing a glass lid and a multi-tiered stainless steel interior. (5) The scene shifts to a white countertop where the thermal cooker and a smaller container are displayed next to a stainless steel pot on a black induction cooktop. (6) Two stacks of luggage/shopping bags on wheels, one grey and one beige, are shown in a hallway near an arched doorway. (7) A person's hand places a folded beige camping chair onto the floor next to floral arrangements. The camera zooms in on the chair's texture and 'Kakaii' logo. (8) The woman is now seated in the beige camping chair, covered with a grey blanket, holding a 'ROLEX' magazine and posing. (9) The woman poses with the chair's cylindrical storage bag on her lap, smiling and looking off-camera. (10) The photographer is seen taking rapid shots of the chair and the woman from a side angle.
